question_text: Show the hour-by-hour person_entry count at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC). List each UTC hour (00 through 23) with its count.

gold.sql: SELECT strftime('%H', timestamp_epoch_s, 'unixepoch') AS hour_utc, COUNT(*) AS count FROM events WHERE camera_location='Gate_MainEntrance' AND event_type='person_entry' AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY hour_utc ORDER BY hour_utc

metadata.note: Tests hour-bucketing via strftime; should expose 08-10, 12-13, 17-19 peaks.
